title: Harden Linux application discovery and browser destination classification.
changes: Read Linux XDG application launchers using pinned directory/file descriptors with O_DIRECTORY and O_NOFOLLOW; refuse replaced symlinks, non-regular files and oversized entries without executing their contents.

Reject malformed hosts with repeated trailing DNS dots, including private IPv4, reserved DNS names and IPv4-compatible/mapped IPv6; preserve normal public navigation and strictly loopback-only CDP endpoint trust.
Add deterministic property-based fast-check fuzz coverage for browser host classification and malformed CDP origins; this dependency is development-only.

Preserve the DLL-free source-release Windows profile, existing consent boundaries and opt-in WebRTC behavior. Unsigned native workers remain separately staged QA artifacts; no automatic screen capture or new permissions are enabled.
